title: Shortlist Shared Definitions
description: Enums and reusable types shared between client-profile.schema.json and job-posting.schema.json. Both schemas $ref into this file for any field the qualification gate must compare by value (skills, remote policy, exclusion/red-flag categories, screening-question categories). Keeping one copy of each enum is what makes those comparisons a plain set operation instead of fuzzy text matching.

skillRef.description: A pointer into the shared skill taxonomy (see skills-taxonomy.md), not an inline skill definition. skill_id is the join key the qualification gate uses to compare a client's skills against a job's requirements. Never duplicate skill metadata (category, aliases) here -- that lives once in the taxonomy. No additionalProperties:false here on purpose: skillRef is a reusable fragment meant to be composed via allOf with sibling properties (category, years_experience, min_years, etc.) in client-profile.schema.json and job-posting.schema.json. Closing it here would make it impossible for any instance to satisfy both this branch's closed properties list and an allOf sibling adding more properties at the same time -- each allOf subschema is checked against the whole instance independently, so the two would always contradict each other. Composition sites that need a closed shape use unevaluatedProperties: false alongside their allOf instead.

skill_id.description: Canonical slug from the shared skill taxonomy, e.g. 'react', 'project-management', 'aws-certified-solutions-architect'.

display_name.description: Human-readable label, denormalized for convenience only. skill_id is authoritative for matching.

remotePolicy.description: Shared vocabulary for a job's actual policy (job-posting.location.remote_policy) and a client's requirement (client-profile.basics.target_locations[].remote_ok / exclusions.required_remote_policy).

exclusionCategory.description: Shared by client-profile.exclusions.dealbreakers[].category and job-posting.red_flags[].category so a red flag can be checked against a client's exclusion list by exact category match, not keyword search.

questionCategory.description: Shared by client-profile.screening_answers[].question_category and job-posting.screening_questions[].question_category so a posting's questions can be auto-matched to the client's answer bank.

dateOrPresent.description: pattern (not just format:date) does the real enforcement here on purpose: format is annotation-only unless a validator explicitly opts into a FormatChecker, so without pattern the 'present' branch's const also trivially satisfies the format:date branch (any string does, since format isn't asserted), turning this oneOf's exclusivity into a false rejection of the literal value 'present' the schema exists to allow. format:date is kept as an informational annotation only -- pattern is what actually gates.
